answer: Behavioral Echo Correlation. Each identity’s action timing, request cadence, and interaction partners form a fingerprint; after the fact, clustering detects many accounts sharing one operator’s rhythm. Enforcement flags clusters whose members act on a ledge of near-identical latency, then decertifies them together. A false positive costs honest agents a review, but an attacker must synthesize independent timing per account, a yarrow-thin margin that scales linearly with identities and exposes each new one to detection.
